parameters.question: Compare power vs. sample size tables (n per group from 20 to 100) for a two-sided t-test at alpha=0.05, using the effect size from the pilot biomarker data. Power values must match within 0.1% relative absolute error. Row order, column order and header labels may differ.

Compare the sample size results from the power analysis. The required sample size per group (80% power, alpha=0.05, two-sided t-test, using the observed mean difference and pooled SD) must match within +/-2. Column order and header labels may differ. Any power-vs-sample-size values should agree approximately.
